_comment: Single source of truth for the card catalogue, shared by config.sh (bash) and quota.py (python).
Both quota metrics are checked per card. The GPU metric is reliable. The CPU metric's LIMIT is
reliable; its reported USAGE is NOT -- measured 2026-09-15: A2_CPUS usage read 0 in us-central1
while another team's a2-highgpu-1g (12 vCPU) was RUNNING there. So the A2_CPUS check is
CONSERVATIVE, not authoritative: it may refuse a launch GCE would have accepted. It errs toward
refusing, which is the right direction for a preflight.
Prices are public LIST prices captured 2026-09-15 for us-central1: an estimate for the cost line,
not an invoice. Spot prices float; reconcile against billing for anything that matters.
prices_note: public list price, us-central1, whole-VM USD/hour; estimate, not an invoice

l4.note: iteration card. 2 of 8 are held by another team's running instances in us-central1.

a100-40.note: THE TRAINING PATH, on spot. On-demand quota is 1 and is already consumed by another team.

a100-80.note: ZERO quota in us-central1 and europe-west4 -- but NVIDIA_A100_80GB_GPUS = 2 (1 free) in us-east4, on-demand only (spot 80GB is 0 in every region). Use --region us-east4. 80 GB A100s are also free at point of use on CSF3, which remains the right home for 80 GB work.

unavailable.h100: no NVIDIA_H100_80GB_GPUS quota in ANY region of this project (all regions scanned 2026-09-15)
unavailable.h200: no NVIDIA_H200_GPUS quota in ANY region of this project (all regions scanned 2026-09-15)
